title: Create identity configuration API endpoints
description:
Create chatbot/api/config.py with FastAPI router endpoints for relationship configuration and character profile CRUD, and register the router in chatbot/api/app.py.

Endpoints to implement:

GET /api/config/relationship/{session_id}
- Returns the RelationshipConfig for a session, or defaults if none stored

PUT /api/config/relationship/{session_id}
- Accepts a JSON body with partial RelationshipConfig fields
- Validates fields (type, tone must be valid literals; directness/warmth/initiative clamped 0.0–1.0; content_level must be valid)
- Persists to the database via RelationshipConfigModel
- Returns the saved config

GET /api/config/character/{session_id}
- Returns the CharacterProfile for a session, or defaults if none stored

PUT /api/config/character/{session_id}
- Accepts a JSON body with partial CharacterProfile fields
- Validates fields (humor_style, communication_style must be valid literals; sliders clamped 0.0–1.0; name and backstory non-empty strings)
- Persists to the database via CharacterProfileModel
- Returns the saved profile

GET /api/config/identity/{session_id}
- Returns the current IdentityState for a session (fixed, slow, mood)

POST /api/config/identity/{session_id}/evolve
- Accepts an optional turn_context dict
- Calls identity_state.apply_evolution() with the context
- Persists the updated IdentityState
- Returns the new state

POST /api/config/identity/{session_id}/reset-mood
- Resets mood to default and persists
- Returns the new state

Use Pydantic models for request/response validation. Follow existing FastAPI router patterns in the chatbot/api/ package (parameter style, error responses, dependency injection). Import RelationshipConfig, CharacterProfile, and IdentityState from chatbot.soul.* modules. Import RelationshipConfigModel, CharacterProfileModel, and IdentityStateModel from chatbot.db.models.

In chatbot/api/app.py, add one line to include the config router: app.include_router(config_router, prefix="/api/config", tags=["config"])

Expected files: chatbot/api/config.py (created), chatbot/api/app.py (modified)

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/api/app.py (FastAPI app setup, existing router registration patterns, import conventions)
- chatbot/api/chat.py (or any existing api router for endpoint patterns)
- chatbot/soul/relationship.py
- chatbot/soul/character.py
- chatbot/soul/evolution.py
- chatbot/db/models.py

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/api/config.py exists with a FastAPI router

GET/PUT /api/config/character/{session_id} endpoints exist and return valid JSON

chatbot/api/app.py includes the config router via app.include_router()
No file outside chatbot/api/config.py and chatbot/api/app.py is created or modified
